summary: Fix money rounding and largest-remainder bill splitting (negative totals, float amounts/weights) in a small billing package.
what_tests_check: Negative splits mirror positive ones and sum exactly, ties to earlier party, float weights behave like their decimal repr, to_cents rounds half away from zero for floats/str/Decimal (1.005, -10.005, 0.125), invoice line/discount/tax rounding, huge totals, plus regressions of formatting, parsing, validation and existing invoice totals.
